name: Fluvoxamine and tizanidine are contraindicated
actions: Do not coadminister fluvoxamine and tizanidine; use an alternative.

rationale: The labeled combination is contraindicated due to hypotension and sedation.

explanation_template: Fluvoxamine inhibits tizanidine metabolism through CYP1A2. This combination is contraindicated because tizanidine exposure can rise markedly, causing hypotension and sedation.

references.citation: Concomitant tizanidine and fluvoxamine is contraindicated.
